info.title: OpenAgentSearch 业务 API
info.description: 三个同步操作。整数词法、项目限额、网页实际访问目标和引用完整性由服务端校验。

post.summary: 检索、打分、分段摘要与整体总结
post.description: 按项目配置改写、检索、去重、评分、取文并总结。按模型上下文选择一次生成或分批。需要配置模型。项目 search_original_query 默认开启；关闭后只检索改写查询，若无可用改写返回 QUERY_REWRITE_FAILED，原问题仍用于评分及总结。同步请求总时限 45 秒。

post.x-description-en: Rewrites, retrieves, deduplicates, scores and synthesizes using project configuration. Context determines single or batched generation. Requires a model. The original question remains part of retrieval. Synchronous deadline is 45 seconds.

message.description: 由 Accept-Language 选择的中英文说明。
message.x-description-en: Chinese or English explanation selected by Accept-Language.

details.description: 字段、限额等公开细节，无额外信息时为 null。
details.x-description-en: Public details such as a field or limit, null when absent.

request_id.description: 请求标识，可在请求记录中追踪。
request_id.x-description-en: Request identifier for tracing in request records.

status.description: success 完整成功，partial 有可用结果但存在损失，empty 合法空结果，error 失败。
status.x-description-en: success is complete, partial has usable results with processing loss, empty is a valid empty result, and error indicates failure.

data.description: 本操作的结果，失败时为 null。

warnings.description: 可处理的损失或截断提示，正常时为空数组。
warnings.x-description-en: Recoverable loss or truncation warnings, empty when absent.

error.description: 失败代码、说明和细节，成功时为 null。
error.x-description-en: Failure code, message and details, null on success.

query.description: 要检索的自然语言问题，1–2048 个 Unicode 字符，至少含一个非空白字符。保留明确的地点和时间。
query.x-description-en: Natural-language question, 1–2048 Unicode characters with at least one non-whitespace character. Explicit places and dates are preserved.

language.description: 业务语言标签，如 zh、en、ja、fr 或 zh-TW。决定语言优先路由的起始搜索池，并指导总结输出语言。省略时从第一池开始，总结使用问题语言。Accept-Language 单独控制错误文案。
language.x-description-en: Business language tag, such as zh, en, ja, fr or zh-TW. Selects the starting search pool through language preferences and guides summary language. Omit to start at the first pool and use the question language. Accept-Language controls error messages separately.

time_range.description: 结果发布时间筛选，以请求到达时刻为基准。day 最近 24 小时，month 最近 30 天，year 最近 365 天。省略时不限时间。只派发给支持该窗口的来源。current_time 单独作为问题改写参照。
time_range.x-description-en: Publication-time filter relative to request arrival. day means 24 hours, month 30 days and year 365 days. Omit for unrestricted dates. Only sources supporting this window participate. current_time separately provides the rewriting reference.

count.description: 最多返回的结果数，整数 1–10 且不得超过项目 search_limit。省略使用项目值，初始为 10。实际命中数可以更少。
count.x-description-en: Maximum result count, an integer from 1 to 10 within project search_limit. Defaults to that project value, initially 10. Fewer matches may be returned.

url.description: 要提取的单个公开 HTTP(S) 网页 URL。目标与重定向均须通过访问校验，禁止 URL 内凭据与内网地址。
url.x-description-en: One public HTTP(S) webpage URL. The target and redirects must pass access validation. Embedded credentials and private addresses are rejected.

max_chars.description: 正文字符上限，正整数且不得超过项目 body_limit。省略使用项目值，初始为 40000。同时限制 Markdown 和纯文本并保留相同内容前缀，截断时附警告。
max_chars.x-description-en: Positive article character limit within project body_limit, initially 40000. Limits Markdown and plain text while retaining a common content prefix. Truncation produces a warning.

query.description: 要检索的自然语言问题，1–2048 个 Unicode 字符，至少含一个非空白字符。保留明确的地点和时间。
query.x-description-en: Natural-language question, 1–2048 Unicode characters with at least one non-whitespace character. Explicit places and dates are preserved.

language.description: 业务语言标签，如 zh、en、ja、fr 或 zh-TW。决定语言优先路由的起始搜索池，并指导总结输出语言。省略时从第一池开始，总结使用问题语言。Accept-Language 单独控制错误文案。
language.x-description-en: Business language tag, such as zh, en, ja, fr or zh-TW. Selects the starting search pool through language preferences and guides summary language. Omit to start at the first pool and use the question language. Accept-Language controls error messages separately.

time_range.description: 结果发布时间筛选，以请求到达时刻为基准。day 最近 24 小时，month 最近 30 天，year 最近 365 天。省略时不限时间。只派发给支持该窗口的来源。current_time 单独作为问题改写参照。
time_range.x-description-en: Publication-time filter relative to request arrival. day means 24 hours, month 30 days and year 365 days. Omit for unrestricted dates. Only sources supporting this window participate. current_time separately provides the rewriting reference.

source_count.description: 最多参与回答的去重来源数，整数 1–10 且不得超过项目 source_limit。省略使用项目值，初始为 4。先打分过滤再选择来源。
source_count.x-description-en: Maximum distinct sources, an integer from 1 to 10 within project source_limit. Defaults to that project value, initially 4. Sources are scored and filtered before selection.

max_chars.description: 整体回答 summary 的字符上限，正整数且不得超过项目 summary_limit。省略使用项目值，初始为 1200。原文材料长度由项目 body_limit 单独决定。
max_chars.x-description-en: Positive maximum length of summary within project summary_limit, initially 1200. Project body_limit separately controls source text.

region.description: 调用方地区，如广州市天河区，1–128 个 Unicode 字符。用于补全附近、当地等指代。省略时不猜地点，仍执行启用的改写。问题中的明确地点优先。
region.x-description-en: Caller region, 1–128 Unicode characters. Resolves implicit local references. Omit to preserve unknown locations while still rewriting when enabled. Explicit places take precedence.

current_time.description: 带偏移的 RFC 3339 当地时间，如 2026-11-22T10:30:00+08:00。按其日期解释今天、昨天。省略使用服务本地时间，Helm 默认 Asia/Shanghai。问题中的明确日期优先。
current_time.x-description-en: Caller-local RFC 3339 timestamp with offset, such as 2026-11-22T10:30:00+08:00. Resolves relative dates using its calendar date. Omit to use service-local time, Asia/Shanghai by default in Helm. Explicit dates take precedence.

content.description: 去除控件和普通链接结果后的语义文本，保留表格、数值和可读代码。一次调用的卡片内容总计不超过 8192 个字符。

engine.description: 生成本卡片的搜索引擎。

content.description: 本次搜索的已完成 AI 回答。需完成标记、有效引用及 200 毫秒稳定期；提交后最早 4 秒返回，等待受本次调用剩余预算及最多 7 秒限制。未就绪时省略整个 engine_answer。
content.x-description-en: Completed AI answer with completion evidence, valid citations and 200 ms stability. Return starts at four seconds after submission within the remaining call budget and a seven-second cap. Omitted when not ready.
